paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: millisecond whole-disk file search via the local Everything index
# dsh-everything
中文文档
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives the agent an **`everything_search`** tool: whole-disk fil
e and folder search in **milliseconds**, powered by the local Everything (voidtools) index.
Instead of recursively scanning directories (glob) when the model needs to locate a file, the agent
asks Everything's pre-built index — instant even on drives with millions of files. Two channels are
used: Everything's built-in HTTP JSON server (loopback only, auto-enabled — no process spawn per cal
l, native UTF-8, exact totals) with the official command line `es.exe` as an always-available fallba
ck for everything the HTTP server cannot express.
## Requirements
- **Windows** (Everything is a Windows-only application; on other platforms the plugin registers a s

tub that fails with a clear message)
- Everything 1.4+ and the ES command line tool (`es.exe`) — **i
nstalled automatically on first use** (see below)
### Automatic backend setup (default)
With `autoInstall: true` (the default), the plugin provisions the backend by itself when it is missi
h `autoInstall: true` (the default), the plugin provisions the backend by itself when it is missing:
1. Resolves the **latest stable** ES CLI from the voidtools.com downloads page, downloads the zip, a

nd extracts `es.exe` to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-everything\bin` (per-user, no admin).
2. Installs **Ever
ything** via `winget install voidtools.Everything` when winget is available, otherwise downloads the

latest stable official setup and runs it silently — either path may show **one UAC prompt**.
3. Lau
nches Everything and waits for its IPC before searching.
Downloads always go **direct first** — no proxy is needed, and a stale system-proxy setting can neve
r break the install. A proxy (`HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` env, or the Windows system proxy) is only u
sed as a fallback. Integrity: when the resolved version matches the known-good release recorded in `
setup.js`, the download is SHA256-verified; a newer upstream release is verified by its **voidtools
Authenticode signature** instead. If the downloads page is unreachable, the recorded known-good rele
ase (SHA256-verified) is used. Installs fail closed when verification fails.
The plugin also keeps its **self-installed** copy of `es.exe` current: on startup it compares the fi
le version against the pinned known-good release and upgrades the copy it owns (user-managed install
s are never touched).
Set `autoInstall: false` if you prefer to install the backend yourself:

Published on npm as `dsh-everything`; installing from the package directory works too.
## Tool: `everything_search`
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| `query` *(required)* | string | Everything search expression: `report ext:docx`, `*.sln dm:thiswee
k`, `path:\projects\ ext:py`. Space = AND, `\|` = OR, `!` = NOT. Multi-word queries are split into e

s.exe terms automatically. |
| `path` | string | Restrict to a directory and its subtree (absolute p

ath). |
| `maxResults` | integer | Result cap (default 100, ceiling 1000). |
| `offset` | integer |

Skip leading results (pagination). |
| `sort` | string | e.g. `date-modified-descending`, `size-desc
ending`, `name-ascending`. Keys: `name`, `path`, `size`, `extension`, `date-created`, `date-modified

`, `date-accessed`, `run-count`, plus `-ascending`/`-descending`. |
| `regex` | boolean | Treat `que

ry` as a full-path regular expression. |
| `matchCase` | boolean | Case-sensitive matching (default:

insensitive). |
| `wholeWord` | boolean | Match whole words only. |
| `foldersOnly` / `filesOnly` |

boolean | Restrict result type. |
| `dateCreated` | boolean | Also return each result's creation da

te. |
| `countOnly` | boolean | Return only the total match count — the fastest way to check existen

ce or estimate volume. |
| `exactTotal` | boolean | Default `true`. `false` skips the extra match-co
unt round-trip on full pages and reports a `≥N` total instead. |
Returns `{ query, total, totalExact, truncated, results: [{ path, size, dateModified, dateCreated? }
], channel, notes }` (`channel` is `"http"` or `"es"`; `notes` carries query-interpretation remarks)
and renders in the chat as a search-paths card.
Typical queries: `report ext:docx` · `*.sln dm:thisweek` · `size:>500mb` · `notes !archive` · recent
ly changed files with `sort: date-modified-descending` + `dm:thisweek`.
> **Phrase quirks:** a quoted phrase only matches the *name* part, so `"report.docx"` matches nothin
g — pass it unquoted. A quoted phrase **containing spaces that is the whole query** (an exact multi-
word match) is automatically converted to an equivalent regex; one embedded alongside other terms de

grades to ANDed words and is reported in `notes` (use `regex=true` for those).
[该节后续省略]
## Configuration
Edit the plugin's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml` (or your profile's patch layer):
| Key | Default | Description |

| `esPath` | auto-detect | Absolute path to `es.exe`. |
| `everythingPath` | sibling of `esPath` | A

bsolute path to `Everything.exe`, used by autoStart. |
| `autoStart` | `true` | Launch Everything an

d wait for its IPC when it is not running. |
| `autoInstall` | `true` | Download & install Everythin

g + ES CLI when missing (see above). |
| `installDir` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-everything` | Where the

auto-installed ES CLI lives. |
| `maxResults` | `100` | Default per-call result cap. |
| `timeoutMs`

| `8000` | Per-call timeout (ms). |
| `httpPort` | `5151` | Everything HTTP server port for the fas

t channel; `0` disables the HTTP channel entirely. |
| `httpAutoEnable` | `true` | When the HTTP ser
ver is down, once per session: patch Everything's own config (unlock + enable + loopback bind) and r

estart its GUI. Set `false` to never touch Everything's config. |
| `httpUsername` / `httpPassword`
| `''` | Optional Basic-auth credentials for the HTTP server. |
## Privacy
The search scope is **every indexed drive** on the machine, and result paths are sent to the model a
s tool output. Keep that in mind on machines with sensitive directory layouts; use `path` to scope s
earches. The HTTP fast path listens on `127.0.0.1` only — nothing is exposed to the network.
